281338781.description:
Product Overview:
This collection features a variety of natural mineral and crystal specimens including a druzy quartz geode slice, blue lace agate slice, polished agate slices, and an amethyst cluster section. Each piece displays unique characteristics such as banded patterns, crystalline centers, and natural color variations.

Specifications:
- Druzy quartz geode slice with gray druzy crystals and a banded brown rind
- Blue lace agate slice with intricate banded patterns in gray, white, and tan
- Polished agate slices with brown and amber banded edges; one with white and gray crystalline center, the other with amber inclusions
- Amethyst cluster section featuring purple crystal points surrounding a hollow center

Each specimen shows natural variation in color, size, and crystal formation typical of geological samples.
